key_insight: Short-wave instabilities in helical vortices saturate weakly at lower linear growth rates but substantially deform the vortex at higher growth rates.
engineering_relevance: These dynamics may inform wind-turbine tip-vortex control strategies aimed at accelerating wake recovery and improving performance.
method: Direct numerical simulations of helical vortices with axial flow.
Vary normalized core radius and reduced pitch for elliptic and curvature instability modes.
Compare nonlinear evolution with weakly nonlinear analysis.
evidence_signal: The parameter sweep reveals structure-preserving saturation at lower growth rates and stronger deformation, higher-order nonlinear effects, and additional modal contributions at higher rates.
watch_item: The abstract reports idealized vortex simulations, not an AI surrogate or validation of control strategies in turbine wakes.
paper_title: Nonlinear dynamics of short-wave instabilities in a helical vortex within and beyond the weakly nonlinear regime
